short_description: Countdowns to a date, or to every year, month, weekday, day or hour; made on the bar and switched with the wheel.
changelog: First release: any number of countdowns made, edited and switched on the bar, each once or repeating yearly, monthly, weekly, daily or hourly; cyan, amber and red states with a beat in the final hour; a full-display final hour; a red count-up with a chime past zero; and the back display.
